blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — More than 100 students in Manito, Albay, who had been holding classes in makeshift spaces after Super Typhoon Uwan (international name: Fung-wong) struck, now have a permanent classroom following its turnover to Inang Maharang Elementary School. The 7-by-9-meter classroom was built through a partnership between Grab Philippines and HOPE, which raised about P1.4 million through the Grab HOPE Hour initiative. The campaign encouraged Grab users to donate GrabCoins and book eligible GrabCar rides and GrabFood orders, with their contributions supporting the construction of classrooms for Filipino students.
